system.summary: A sign cipher; the key has not been rebuilt here. A different alphabet from Łaski's 1531 key to the Bavarian dukes (kaa4591).
system.notes: 5-2-2 (N.N., Venice, 18 Jan 1541, Spanish, to Charles V) is not Łaski's and is left out (issue #172).

solution.what: Read issue #172 (Brackx, 28 Oct 2026): AIS notes interlinear decipherments; all letters printed by Gévay vol. 3, Beilagen 27-53. Confirmed the Internet Archive item urkundenundacten113gv is Gévay's edition.
Searched the repo targets and issues for another entry or attempt on catalogue 497; none.

outcome.method_basis: The originals carry contemporary interlinear decipherments and Gévay (1842) printed every letter in full; found by Michael Brackx (issue #172).
outcome.fraction_read_source: Gévay prints each letter in full; not counted here (no transcription)
outcome.notes: Nothing about the text is new. No cipher transcription or key here; open work is a sign-by-sign transcription checked against Gévay and the interlinear gloss.
